# Berth availability board

With tide windows in the store (HL-001), a skipper's only question is which
berth is free and when. This endpoint answers it in one round trip.

## Contract

`GET /api/v1/berths` returns one row per berth with its next free window, or
`null` when the berth has no window inside the published almanac.
